title: Failure probability bound
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, and let $0<\tau\le1$. The probability that the trace produced by the Goldreich–Levin query program contains an estimate whose error from its corresponding restricted Fourier weight is at least $\tau^2/4$ is at most $1/20$.
